portfolio.title: AI-Driven Software Developer
portfolio.heroBio: Software developer specializing in React, TypeScript, and full-stack web applications with 4 years of experience building scalable systems.
portfolio.aboutBio1: I build performant web applications, modern interfaces, and robust integrations with 4 years of professional experience across telecom systems.
portfolio.aboutBio2: Tel Aviv, Israel · Available for hybrid or remote roles.

bullets: Developed custom AEM components & modular JS for a high-traffic eCommerce platform, ensuring reusable, high-performance UI delivery.
Authored technical Confluence documentation and led Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions for engineering onboarding and alignment.
Built automation scripts for mobile event tracking and route management, significantly reducing hardcoded manual overhead.
Architected Adobe Analytics infrastructure across eCommerce and self-service apps, leading client requirement reviews and tracking governance.
Set up the frontend infrastructure and engineered Okta Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication, automated deep-link logins, and secure checkout flow continuity.
Drove high-impact Proof of Concepts (POCs) from initial validation into enterprise production deployments.
Conducted rigorous code reviews ensuring architecture standards, code health, and maintainability.
Built core eCommerce, retail, and mobile flows using React, TypeScript, Redux-Saga, Material UI, and SCSS in an Agile framework.
Designed and delivered the end-to-end Home Broadband checkout funnel from architectural design to production launch.
Provided onsite technical release support in the UK, resolving live production blockers during mission-critical go-live windows.
Contributed to full-site migration from React/Contentful to Drupal, Vue, and PHP, rebuilding and optimizing the subscriber purchase funnel.
Implemented custom CMS components and admin tooling utilizing Vue, GraphQL, PHP, and Twig.
Partnered with product, design, and QA leads across Jira, Bitbucket, and Acquia to accelerate release delivery.

recommendations.author: Ehud Marchi
recommendations.quote: I had the pleasure of working with Matan, and he is a highly responsible and dedicated developer. He’s a great team player, reliable, supportive, and always willing to help. Matan is the kind of person who can make a real impact and be a valuable part of any team. I highly recommend him.

recommendations.author: Adarsh Singh
recommendations.quote: I had a great experience working with Matan, his frontend technical skills and collaborative approach make him a wonderful team player. I'd highly recommend him and wish him a very good luck.

recommendations.author: Noam Shmueli
recommendations.quote: It was a true pleasure working alongside Matan. He is an exceptionally precise and thoughtful software engineer who approaches every problem with high attention to detail. Beyond his technical sharpness, Matan is the ultimate team player - always willing to jump in to assist teammates, review code thoroughly, and contribute constructively to team discussions. I’d welcome the chance to work with him again without hesitation.

recommendations.author: John Yaghobieh
recommendations.quote: I highly recommend Matan. He is an incredibly hardworking professional who always tackles challenges head-on. He consistently goes above and beyond, taking full ownership of his projects. He is a natural leader who knows how to step up and drive things forward, maintaining the highest level of professionalism in everything he does. Any team would be lucky to have him on board.

recommendations.author: Refael Huri
recommendations.quote: It was an absolute pleasure working with Matan on our software engineering project. Matan is a highly talented, dedicated, and detail-oriented developer who consistently delivers high-quality code and robust solutions. Throughout our collaboration, he demonstrated exceptional problem-solving skills, a deep understanding of software architecture, and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges efficiently. Beyond his technical prowess, Matan is a fantastic team player-collaborative, communicative, and always willing to support his peers. Any development team would be lucky to have him.

recommendations.author: Tomer Steiner
recommendations.quote: I had the pleasure of working with Matan at Amdocs, where we were part of the same team, collaborating on the development of our project's website. Matan is an excellent UI Developer with strong expertise in React and modern front-end technologies. He consistently demonstrated great technical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver high-quality, clean, and maintainable code. Beyond his technical abilities, Matan is a great team player, always willing to collaborate, share knowledge, and help others. He is professional, dedicated, and brings a positive attitude to the team. I highly recommend Matan to any team looking for a talented and reliable Front-End Developer.

recommendations.author: Omri Biton
recommendations.quote: I had the pleasure of working alongside Matan at Amdocs on the Digital UI program for Altice, where we were both frontend developers on the same customer-facing platform. Matan is a strong full-stack developer with deep frontend skills. He's highly proficient in React, JavaScript and modern UI tooling. What stands out most is his curiosity and drive to keep improving. He's always among the first to explore new technologies, whether that's upgrading our component tooling or adopting AI-assisted development tools early and showing the team how much time they can save. He contributed to successful deliveries, including an Okta integration demo that was well received. He's also a great teammate. He's generous with his knowledge, always ready to discuss an architecture idea or help debug a tricky configuration, and he's honest and practical when giving advice. Any team would be lucky to have Matan. I highly recommend him.
